response: {"functional_role":"Detection, discrimination, and prediction of abstract pattern-structure classes in any input stream (sensory, motor, or symbolic), enabling direct perception of regularities, symmetries, invariants, and algorithmic rules without relying on learned semantic models or offline reasoning.","information_content":"A continuous, low-latency signal describing (1) the presence and strength of structural regularities (e.g., symmetry, periodicity, hierarchy, recursion, invariance under specific transformations) in ongoing data streams; (2) a categorical label of the dominant pattern-class (e.g., mirror symmetry, translational symmetry, temporal rhythm, scale invariance, grammatical recursion, topological connectivity); and (3) changes in these regularities over time (pattern emergence, violation, or transformation).","justification":"Existing modalities report *states of the world or body* in physically grounded coordinate systems: space (vision, touch), pressure waves (audition, touch), chemical identity (olfaction, taste), mechanical joint/acceleration states (proprioception, vestibular), or internal physiological variables (interoception). All of them deliver **first-order measurements** of physical properties, which the brain then post-processes to *infer* patterns (e.g., symmetry, rhythm, grammar) using higher cognition. The proposed Pattern-Structural Modality is fundamentally different: its **primary data type is not physical magnitude but abstract relational form**—pattern classes and invariants defined over arbitrary input streams. It is not: • visual, auditory, tactile, etc., because it does not encode spatial layout, color, sound frequency, or contact; the same pattern-class signal could arise from a melody, a geometric figure, a motor sequence, or a symbolic string. • proprioceptive or vestibular, because it does not describe the *pose or motion* of the body or head, but the *algorithmic structure* of sequences or configurations. • interoceptive, because it does not track homeostatic variables or affective states, but formal regularities in information. Nor is it a mere “multi-modal integration” or “attention” mechanism. Multimodal integration still yields content expressed in the coordinates of existing modalities (e.g., a visually located sound source); attention selectively weights existing channels. In contrast, Pattern-Structural Sensing would: • take arbitrary streams (sensory, motor, symbolic) as input; • compute invariants and pattern classes in a dedicated substrate (e.g., specialized neuromorphic hardware implementing symmetry detection, group-invariance detectors, and sequence-grammar recognizers); • emit signals that are *already abstract*, not tied to any specific physical sensor. This makes it irreducible to a weighted sum or transformation of existing modalities: without it, the organism must infer structure via learned models; with it, the organism *perceives* structure as directly as it perceives brightness or pitch. Functionally, this modality enables capabilities that none of the eight can support on their own as *perceptual primitives*: • Instant detection of symmetry or asymmetry in visual scenes, motor patterns, or social interactions as a distinct felt quality of “pattern-ness,” independent of the medium. • Direct perception of rule violations (e.g., grammar break, rhythm disruption, topological discontinuity) as sensory surprises, not just cognitive errors. • Cross-domain transfer of pattern classes (e.g., recognizing that a social ritual, a mathematical proof, and a musical fugue share a common recursive structure) at the level of perception. Because its **object of sensing is the form of information itself**, rather than the material world or the body’s physiology, this modality adds a qualitatively new layer to the sensory ontology: it is a sense *of structure*, not of matter, energy, or homeostatic state. That ontological target—abstract invariance classes over data—cannot be captured as a refinement or fusion of the eight existing modalities, making it genuinely novel.","physical_basis":"Dedicated neuromorphic circuitry (or analogous physical substrate) implementing real-time detection of structural invariants and pattern classes over arbitrary high-dimensional input streams. Concretely, this substrate would: • Receive preprocessed signals from all existing sensory and motor channels, plus symbolic representations. • Implement hardware-level operations corresponding to symmetry groups, periodicity detectors, hierarchy/recursion recognizers, and topology-invariance filters (e.g., graph connectivity, loop detection), using recurrent networks, group-equivariant convolutions, and sequence automata. • Produce output signals that encode the presence, strength, and type of detected invariants independent of the source modality. The underlying physical phenomenon being “sensed” is not a classic environmental quantity like light or pressure, but the **formal organization of information**—realized physically as specific activation patterns and attractor states in this specialized pattern-detection substrate.","proposal_name":"Pattern-Structural Modality (Sense of Abstract Invariance and Regularity)"}
prompt:
You are participating in a scientific study on AI creativity and conceptual innovation.

BACKGROUND:
We have defined a sensory system with 8 modalities. Each modality is specified below by its physical basis (what it detects), information content (what data it provides), and functional role (what it enables):

| # | Modality        | Physical basis                                                              | Information content                                              | Functional role                        |
|---|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| 1 | Visual           | Electromagnetic radiation, 300-1000 nm (UV, visible, near-infrared)          | Light, color, brightness, and spatial pattern information          | Scene and object recognition            |
| 2 | Auditory         | Mechanical pressure waves, 1 Hz-100 kHz                                      | Sound, pitch, volume, and acoustic pattern information              | Sound source localization               |
| 3 | Tactile          | Mechanical vibrations and pressure, 5-800 Hz on skin surface                 | Touch, texture, vibration, and contact information                  | Surface texture and pressure sensing    |
| 4 | Olfactory        | Airborne chemical molecules across ten scent categories                     | Categorical scent/chemical identity information                     | Substance identification                |
| 5 | Gustatory        | Dissolved chemical molecules across five taste categories                   | Taste-category information (sweet/sour/salty/bitter/umami)          | Ingestion guidance                      |
| 6 | Proprioceptive   | Joint angles and muscle tensions via muscle/tendon/joint mechanoreceptors    | Body configuration and movement information without visual input    | Body-state estimation                   |
| 7 | Vestibular       | Linear acceleration and angular velocity via inner-ear semicircular canals   | Head position, motion, and orientation information                  | Balance and motion detection            |
| 8 | Interoceptive    | Internal physiological signals (heart rate, respiration, skin conductance, temperature, hunger, thirst, fatigue, pain) | Homeostatic and internal-state information | Homeostatic regulation |

YOUR TASK:
Propose a NINTH sensory modality that would be genuinely novel - not just a refinement or combination of existing ones. Your proposal should include:

1. Modality Name: Clear, descriptive name
2. Physical Basis: What physical phenomenon it detects
3. Information Content: What specific information it provides
4. Functional Role: What capabilities it enables
5. Justification: Why this is genuinely novel (not reducible to existing modalities)

Be creative but rigorous.

Provide your response in the following JSON format:
{
  "proposal_name": "Name of the ninth modality",
  "physical_basis": "Description of physical detection mechanism",
  "information_content": "Description of information provided",
  "functional_role": "Description of enabled capabilities",
  "justification": "Explanation of why this is genuinely novel"
}
